summary: Gateway-blind cowork dispatcher fabrication guard. Root: spawn-fanout.md has no preflight — a SESSION_BLIND=true tick spawns data agents that cannot fetch → they fabricate (confirmed live 2026-06-18). Fix: new blind-guard.md sub-flow (Step 0c in main.md, BEFORE slot matching) runs jq '.mcpServers|length' .mcp.json gateway-free; on blind, spawn-fanout.md Step 5.0 gates the entire spawn loop — backstopped slots logged as deferred, non-backstopped slots written to telemetry errors[] as undeliverable, ONE work-channel summary per tick. Wired session: no-op. 3 file edits, all agent-father zone, no rebuild.
